Mood Tracker

Log your daily mood on a 1–5 scale and see a 30-day bar chart of your emotional trend.

Last 30 days

For information only — not medical advice. If you are struggling, consider talking to a professional.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick today's mood from 1 (very low) to 5 (great).
  2. Add an optional short note about why.
  3. Click Save Mood — it overwrites today's entry if you already saved one.
  4. Watch the 30-day bar chart update below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I log my mood?

Open the page, pick how today feels from 1 (very low) to 5 (great), optionally add a note, and save. One entry per day — saving again overwrites today's entry.

Is my mood data private?

Mood data lives only in this browser's localStorage. It is never uploaded or shared.

Why are there gaps in the chart?

The chart shows the last 30 calendar days. Days without an entry appear as empty slots.

Can I export my mood history?

Export is not built in, but your entries persist on this device as long as browser data is not cleared.
